plugins.name: unflick
plugins.description: Drive the unflick video player from Claude: play local files, discs and 30+ streaming-site URLs, seek to a line of dialogue, clip/GIF, generate & translate subtitles locally, bookmark, equalize, cast to a TV, manage a media library, screenshot. Bundles seven skills and the unflick MCP server (94 tools).
